senses.def: shaped in the form of the letter Y
An imaginary coffin in the shape of a capital letter Y, supposedly used for burying a sexually promiscuous woman.
ex:
Edmund: This is the Jane Herrington?
Percy: Yes.
Edmund: Jane - bury-me-in-a-Y-shaped-coffin - Herrington.
Percy: I.., I think maybe there are two Jane Herringtons.
Edmund: No... Tall, blond, elegant?
Percy: Right, that'
